target.name: Clippership
target.founder: Nico Cymbalist, Luca Cymbalist, Kai Matsuka

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Clippership is a Seed-stage maritime technology company that has raised $5M+. The ocean and maritime sector comp universe consists of three identified private peers—Standard Subsea, NetworkOcean, and Albacore—with no direct public comparables available for triangulation.

The stage-progression method is the applicable valuation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $5M as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a $12M valuation. The analysis yields a triangulated range of $11M (low) to $14M (high), with $12M as the median point.

The primary limitation of this analysis is methodological: reliance on a single approach derived from stage norms rather than market multiples or comparable transaction data. The absence of public maritime tech benchmarks and limited visibility into the three private peer valuations constrains confidence in the range. A more robust valuation would benefit from actual revenue multiples or precedent transactions among the identified private comparables. The $11M–$14M range should be treated as preliminary pending deeper market data or closer examination of peer financials.
